params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the site you want to retrieve the baseline data for.

params.name: amount
params.description: Number of timesteps to be included in the time window.

params.name: start
params.description:
Start of window (ISO 8601). Must be a perfect minute without seconds or milliseconds precision.

**Note**: To avoid timezone issues, we perform an additional check for the presence of timezone information. You should always include either UTC with `Z`, or an offset like `+01:00`.

params.name: granularity
params.description: The granularity to fetch the state for, i.e. the time length of each element. It cannot be smaller than 1 minute, and cannot contain sub-minute precision. The expected format is ISO8601.
